products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Charming Holiday Decoration: Elevate your seasonal decoration with this delightful 184 cm tall lighted snowman. The snowman is adorned with a black top hat, a vibrant red scarf, and gloved branch hands, spreading endless joy.
- Appealing Lighting Display: Outfitted with 200 cold white LED lights, this charming snowman emits a sparkling, shimmering light display that captures the magic of the season.
- All-Season Build: Crafted with materials that withstand all weather conditions, this robust snowman decoration is waterproof, snowproof, windproof, and sunproof. The snowman stands up to the elements, maintaining its festive cheer in any climate.
- Pop-up Installation: This snowman features a convenient pop-up construction for easy setup and takedown. The decoration also includes a sturdy round base, 7 ground stakes, 10 zip ties, and a 10 m wind rope, plus a safe adapter.

## Information
Add a touch of winter wonder with this enchanting 184 cm tall lighted snowman.The snowman is designed to bring festive joy both indoors and outdoors. Featuring a sleek black top hat, a bright red scarf, and branch hands with gloves, the snowman is a merry centerpiece that captivates and delights. Equipped with 200 twinkling, cold white LED lights, the festive decoration ensures a luminous display that captures the holiday spirit. Made of weatherproof material, the lighted snowman withstands long-time outdoor use. Celebrate the season with this adorable and sturdy snowman, a perfect addition to your holiday decoration that promises to light up your celebrations year after year.
